parameters: Half a month later, at the Viper Demon's temple.
list._original: それから半月後、毒蛇魔人の神殿にて。

parameters: I've finally found you, Viper Demon.
list._original: ようやく見つけましたよ、毒蛇魔人。

parameters:
Hmm, to think you would make it all the way to this
temple...
list._original: ふむ、まさかこの神殿までたどり着くとは…

parameters:
Vipers of that caliber couldn't even slow me down. ...Fiend
who threatens the people's peace, prepare yourself.
list._original:
あの程度の毒蛇では足止めにもなりません。
…人々の安寧を脅かす魔物よ、覚悟なさい。

parameters:
So this is a Royal Knight. It seems I underestimated you
somewhat.
list._original: これが王宮騎士、少々侮っていたようです。

parameters:
Indeed, my guard snakes appear to be no match for you. Well
then...
list._original:
確かに、警備用の蛇達では相手にならない様子。
では…

parameters:
How would you fare against elite troops summoned by my own
hand?
list._original: 私が直々に召喚した精鋭であれば、いかがでしょう？

parameters: Impossible...that many, wiped out in an instant...!
list._original: ありえない…あの数を一瞬で…！

parameters: Was that your trump card? If so, then this ends here.
list._original:
今のが奥の手ですか？
であれば、これで終わりです。

parameters: Hmph, you let your guard down! At this distance...!
list._original: ふ、油断しましたね！この距離ならば！

parameters:
W-what do you think!? My maximum-concentration poison mist!
Potent enough to corrode even my own poison-resistant flesh!
Royal Knight or not, you're still only human―melted to the
very marrow...!
list._original:
ど、どうです！最大濃度の毒霧！
毒に耐性のある私の肉体ごと腐食させるほどの威力！
いくら王宮騎士といえど所詮は人間、骨の髄までグズグズに…！

parameters:
Rather than melted...it's more slimy, which is somewhat
unpleasant.
list._original: グズグズというか…ヌメヌメして少々気持ち悪いですね。

parameters:
(Had I been unable to nullify the poison, this might have
been a difficult battle... I must thank Sazanna.)
list._original:
(毒を無効化できなければ、苦戦していたかもしれません…
 サザンナに感謝しなければ。)
